import json
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Data
participants = ['P1', 'P2', 'P3']
cars = ['C1', 'C2', 'C3']
possible_assignments = [[1, 0, 1], [0, 1, 0], [1, 1, 1]]

# Create a new model
m = gp.Model()

# Add variables
variables = {}
for p in participants:
    for c in cars:
        var_name = f"x_{p}_{c}"
        variables[var_name] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=var_name)

# Add constraints
# Each participant can be assigned to at most one car
for p in participants:
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(variables[f"x_{p}_{c}"] for c in cars) <= 1, name=f"c1_{p}")

# Each car can be assigned to at most one participant
for c in cars:
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(variables[f"x_{p}_{c}"] for p in participants) <= 1, name=f"c2_{c}")

# Only possible assignments are allowed
for i, p in enumerate(participants):
    for j, c in enumerate(cars):
        if possible_assignments[i][j] == 0:
            m.addConstr(variables[f"x_{p}_{c}"] == 0, name=f"c3_{p}_{c}")

# Set objective
m.setObjective(gp.quicksum(variables[f"x_{p}_{c}"] for p in participants for c in cars), GRB.MAXIMIZE)

# Optimize the model
m.optimize()

# Print the solution
print(json.dumps({"objective_value": float(m.ObjVal), "assignment": {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}}))

import json
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Problem data
jobs = [1, 2, 3]
schedules = [1, 2, 3]
machines = [1, 2]
proces_time = [[1, 3], [2, 2], [3, 1]]

# Create a new model
m = gp.Model()

# Variables
start_time = m.addVars(jobs, machines, name="start_time", vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0)
makespan = m.addVar(name="makespan", vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0)

# Constraints
# Job start time constraints
for j in jobs:
    m.addConstr(start_time[j, 1] == 0, name=f"job_start_time_{j}")

# Machine processing time constraints
for j in jobs:
    for m in machines[:-1]:
        m.addConstr(start_time[j, m+1] >= start_time[j, m] + proces_time[j-1][m-1], name=f"machine_processing_time_{j}_{m}")

# Makespan constraint
for j in jobs:
    m.addConstr(makespan >= start_time[j, machines[-1]] + proces_time[j-1][machines[-1]-1], name=f"makespan_constraint_{j}")

# Objective
m.setObjective(makespan, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Optimize the model
m.optimize()

# Print the results
print(json.dumps({"objective_value": float(makespan.X), "assignment": {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}}))

import json
import gurobipy as gp

# Data
Cities = ['A', 'B']
Links = [['A', 'B']]
Products = ['Product1']
Supply = [[10], [0]]
Demand = [[0], [10]]
ShipmentCost = [[[1]]]
Capacity = [[[10]]]
JointCapacity = [[10]]

# Model
m = gp.Model()

# Variables
x = {}
for i, j in Links:
    for p in Products:
        x[i, j, p] = m.addVar(name=f'x_{i}_{j}_{p}', vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, ub=Capacity[Cities.index(i)][Cities.index(j)][Products.index(p)])

# Constraints
for i in Cities:
    for p in Products:
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i, j, p] for j in Cities if [i, j] in Links) <= Supply[Cities.index(i)][Products.index(p)], name=f'supply_{i}_{p}')
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[j, i, p] for j in Cities if [j, i] in Links) >= Demand[Cities.index(i)][Products.index(p)], name=f'demand_{i}_{p}')

for i, j in Links:
    for p in Products:
        m.addConstr(x[i, j, p] <= Capacity[Cities.index(i)][Cities.index(j)][Products.index(p)], name=f'capacity_{i}_{j}_{p}')
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i, j, p] for p in Products) <= JointCapacity[Cities.index(i)][Cities.index(j)], name=f'joint_capacity_{i}_{j}')

# Objective
m.setObjective(gp.quicksum(ShipmentCost[Cities.index(i)][Cities.index(j)][Products.index(p)] * x[i, j, p] for i, j in Links for p in Products), sense=gp.GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Optimize
m.optimize()

# Output
print(json.dumps({"objective_value": float(m.ObjVal), "assignment": {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}}))

import json
import gurobipy as gp

# Problem data
m = 3  # number of production points
n = 4  # number of demand points
p = 2  # number of intermediate transfer stations

a = [100, 150, 200]  # production capacities
b = [50, 75, 100, 125]  # demand requirements
f = [1000, 1500]  # fixed costs for transfer stations
q = [250, 300]  # capacities of transfer stations
c_ik = [[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]]  # transportation costs from production to transfer
c_kj = [[2, 3, 4, 5], [3, 4, 5, 6]]  # transportation costs from transfer to demand

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Add variables
x = {}
y = {}
for i in range(m):
    for k in range(p):
        for j in range(n):
            x[i, k, j] = m.addVar(name=f'x_{i}_{k}_{j}', lb=0, vtype=gp.GRB.CONTINUOUS)
for k in range(p):
    y[k] = m.addVar(name=f'y_{k}', vtype=gp.GRB.BINARY)

for i in range(m):
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i, k, j] for k in range(p) for j in range(n)) <= a[i], name=f'production_capacity_{i}')
for j in range(n):
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i, k, j] for i in range(m) for k in range(p)) >= b[j], name=f'demand_satisfaction_{j}')
for k in range(p):
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i, k, j] for i in range(m) for j in range(n)) <= q[k] * y[k], name=f'transfer_capacity_{k}')

# Set objective
m.setObjective(gp.quicksum((c_ik[i][k] + c_kj[k][j]) * x[i, k, j] for i in range(m) for k in range(p) for j in range(n)) + gp.quicksum(f[k] * y[k] for k in range(p)), sense=gp.GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Optimize
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(json.dumps({"objective_value": float(m.ObjVal), "assignment": {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}}))

m = gp.Model()

# Variables
y = [m.addVar(vtype=gp.GRB.BINARY, name=f"y{i+1}") for i in range(8)]
x = [[m.addVar(vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, ub=capacities[i], name=f"x{i+1}{j+1}") for j in range(9)] for i in range(8)]

# Constraints
for j in range(9):
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i][j] for i in range(8)) >= demands[j], name=f"c{j+1}")

for i in range(8):
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i][j] for j in range(9)) <= capacities[i] * y[i], name=f"c{i+10}")

# Objective
m.setObjective(gp.quicksum(opening_costs[i] * y[i] for i in range(8)) + gp.quicksum(transportation_costs[i][j] * x[i][j] for i in range(8) for j in range(9)), gp.GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Optimize
m.optimize()

print(json.dumps({"objective_value": float(m.ObjVal), "assignment": {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}}))

x = m.addVars(9, 8, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, name="x")

# Opening costs
opening_costs = [151000, 192000, 114000, 171000, 160000, 120000, 182000, 186000, 174000]

# Transportation costs
transportation_costs = [
    [3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17],
    [4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18],
    [5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, 19],
    [6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20],
    [7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, 19, 21],
    [8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22],
    [9, 11, 13, 15, 17, 19, 21, 23],
    [10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24],
    [11, 13, 15, 17, 19, 21, 23, 25]
]

# Demand
demand = [414, 520, 630, 740, 850, 920, 414, 520]

# Supply capacity
supply_capacity = [1030, 1962, 1500, 1200, 1100, 1300, 1400, 1600, 1700]

# Constraints

X = m.addVar(name="X", vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, lb=0)
Y = m.addVar(name="Y", vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, lb=0)
Z = m.addVar(name="Z", vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, lb=0)

m.addConstr(X + Y + Z <= 1000, name="total_fund")
m.addConstr(X - 2*Y >= 200, name="X_excess")
m.addConstr(Z - Y >= 100, name="Z_excess")

m.setObjective(2*X + 3*Y + 1*Z, sense=gp.GRB.MINIMIZE)

m.optimize()

print(json.dumps({"objective_value": float(m.ObjVal), "assignment": {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}}))

import json
import gurobipy as gp

m = gp.Model()
waiters = m.addVar(name="waiters", vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, lb=0)
managers = m.addVar(name="managers", vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, lb=0)

m.addConstr(waiters + managers >= 50, name="total_workers")
m.addConstr(managers >= 15, name="min_managers")
m.addConstr(managers - (1/3) * waiters >= 0, name="manager_to_waiter_ratio")
m.addConstr(1200 * waiters + 2000 * managers <= 500000, name="wage_bill")

m.setObjective(1200 * waiters + 2000 * managers, sense=gp.GRB.MINIMIZE)

m.optimize()

print(json.dumps({"objective_value": float(m.ObjVal), "assignment": {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}}))

x1_t = m.addVars(6, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="x1_t", lb=0, ub=1)
p0_t = m.addVars(6, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="p0_t", lb=0, ub=127)
p1_t = m.addVars(6, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="p1_t", lb=0, ub=129)
s0_t = m.addVars(6, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="s0_t", lb=0, ub=4)
s1_t = m.addVars(6, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="s1_t", lb=0, ub=1)

# Constraints
demands = [201, 191, 182, 190, 194, 168]
reserve_margin = 1.15

for t in range(6):
    m.addConstr(p0_t[t] + p1_t[t] >= demands[t] * reserve_margin, name=f"demand_{t}")
    m.addConstr(p0_t[t] + p1_t[t] >= demands[t] * reserve_margin, name=f"reserve_{t}")
    m.addConstr(p0_t[t] <= 127, name=f"power_limit_0_{t}")

    m.addConstr(x0_t[t] - s0_t[t] >= 0, name=f"startup_0_{t}")
    m.addConstr(x1_t[t] - s1_t[t] >= 0, name=f"startup_1_{t}")

import json
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

m = gp.Model()

products = [0, 1, 2]
machines = [0, 1]
periods = [0, 1, 2]

produce = m.addVars(products, machines, periods, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="produce")
startup = m.addVars(machines, periods, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="startup")
production_quantity = m.addVars(products, machines, periods, lb=0, name="production_quantity")
inventory = m.addVars(products, periods, lb=0, name="inventory")
backlog = m.addVars(products, periods, lb=0, name="backlog")

demands = {
    (0, 0): 20.33410585875594,
    (0, 1): 22.57961652322203,
    (0, 2): 15.89714240515548,
    (1, 0): 24.05647618194615,
    (1, 1): 20.36522893983323,
    (1, 2): 17.47466293074195,
    (2, 0): 16.36553930950429,
    (2, 1): 22.7831030020558,
    (2, 2): 19.7805033393852
}

# Initial inventory and backlog
inventory_prev = m.addVars(products, lb=0, name="inventory_prev")
backlog_prev = m.addVars(products, lb=0, name="backlog_prev")

# Demand satisfaction
m.addConstrs(
    (gp.quicksum(production_quantity[p, m, t] for m in machines) + inventory_prev[p] - backlog_prev[p] - demands[p, t] + inventory[p, t] - backlog[p, t] == 0
     for p in products for t in periods),
    name="demand_satisfaction"
)

# Machine capacity constraints
m.addConstrs(
    (-71.79935969683524 * production_quantity[p, 0, t] + 6.342821301312698 * startup[0, t] + produce[p, 0, t] <= 0
     for p in products for t in periods),
    name="machine_capacity_0"
)
m.addConstrs(
    (-73.09691843304661 * production_quantity[p, 1, t] + 6.171760083826499 * startup[1, t] + produce[p, 1, t] <= 0
     for p in products for t in periods),
    name="machine_capacity_1"
)

# Single product production per machine per period
m.addConstrs(
    (gp.quicksum(produce[p, m, t] for p in products) <= 1
     for m in machines for t in periods),
    name="single_product_production"
)

# Startup required if production starts
m.addConstrs(
    (produce[p, m, t] - produce[p, m, t-1] - startup[m, t] >= 0
     for p in products for m in machines for t in periods if t > 0),
    name="startup_required"
)

# Objective function
m.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(145.4242073380383 * produce[p, m, t] for p in products for m in machines for t in periods) +
    gp.quicksum(79.18604813454679 * startup[m, t] for m in machines for t in periods) +
    gp.quicksum(0.9008900951620358 * inventory[0, t] for t in periods) +
    gp.quicksum(1.068925395295676 * inventory[1, t] for t in periods) +
    gp.quicksum(1.066244796883431 * inventory[2, t] for t in periods) +
    gp.quicksum(6.734178682720012 * backlog[0, t] for t in periods) +
    gp.quicksum(7.442225721133133 * backlog[1, t] for t in periods) +
    gp.quicksum(7.104627209109436 * backlog[2, t] for t in periods),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

m.optimize()

print(json.dumps({"objective_value": float(m.ObjVal), "assignment": {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}}))

import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Create a new model
m = gp.Model()

# Define variables
produce = m.addVars(2, 2, 3, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="produce")
startup = m.addVars(2, 2, 3, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="startup")
quantity = m.addVars(2, 2, 3, lb=0, name="quantity")
inventory = m.addVars(2, 3, lb=0, name="inventory")
backlog = m.addVars(2, 3, lb=0, name="backlog")

# Set initial inventory and backlog to 0
for p in range(2):
    inventory[p, 0].lb = 0
    backlog[p, 0].lb = 0

# Define demands
demands = {
    (0, 0): 22.92965094851524,
    (0, 1): 19.03396834281949,
    (0, 2): 18.90167422155575,
    (1, 0): 19.80185049682801,
    (1, 1): 24.22810173621122,
    (1, 2): 16.84556169689551
}

# Define machine capacities
capacities = {
    0: 76.7045484622153,
    1: 69.3695364951939
}

# Add demand satisfaction constraints
for p in range(2):
    for t in range(3):
        m.addConstr(
            gp.quicksum(quantity[p, m, t] for m in range(2)) + inventory[p, t-1] - backlog[p, t-1] - inventory[p, t] + backlog[p, t] == demands[p, t],
            name=f"demand_satisfaction_{p}_{t}"
        )

# Add machine capacity constraints
for m in range(2):
    for t in range(3):
        m.addConstr(
            gp.quicksum(quantity[p, m, t] for p in range(2)) + startup[m, t] <= capacities[m],
            name=f"machine_capacity_{m}_{t}"
        )

# Add single product per period constraint
for m in range(2):
    for t in range(3):
        m.addConstr(
            gp.quicksum(produce[p, m, t] for p in range(2)) <= 1,
            name=f"single_product_per_period_{m}_{t}"
        )

# Add startup cost constraint
for m in range(2):
    for t in range(1, 3):
        m.addConstr(
            startup[m, t] >= produce[p, m, t] - produce[p, m, t-1] for p in range(2),
            name=f"startup_cost_{m}_{t}"
        )

# Set objective
m.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(149.1695690337089 * produce[p, m, t] for p in range(2) for m in range(2) for t in range(3)) +
    gp.quicksum(69.24269269143792 * startup[m, t] for m in range(2) for t in range(3)) +

)

capacity = {0: 63.4339018881536, 1: 67.51600987446864}

import gurobipy as gp

# Create the model
m = gp.Model()

# Define the variables
order_vars = [m.addVar(vtype=gp.GRB.BINARY, name=f"order_week_{i+1}") for i in range(21)]
amount_vars = [m.addVar(vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, ub=3157, name=f"amount_week_{i+1}") for i in range(21)]
inventory_vars = [m.addVar(vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, name=f"inventory_week_{i+1}") for i in range(21)]

# Define the demands
demands = [150, 132, 135, 178, 133, 173, 161, 195, 110, 118, 131, 198, 118, 120, 129, 148, 189, 178, 145, 161, 155]

# Define the ordering costs
ordering_costs = [459, 555, 547, 530, 436, 401, 490, 462, 479, 563, 456, 442, 530, 427, 512, 574, 430, 424, 484, 507, 446]

# Define the unit purchase costs
unit_purchase_costs = [49, 48, 55, 44, 51, 48, 53, 43, 42, 52, 45, 42, 43, 42, 59, 57, 57, 44, 57, 60, 43]

# Define the holding costs
holding_costs = [23, 28, 28, 25, 30, 25, 28, 22, 30, 30, 23, 28, 27, 22, 22, 23, 20, 28, 30, 30, 24]

# Add the flow balance constraints
for i in range(21):
    if i == 0:
        m.addConstr(inventory_vars[i] + amount_vars[i] == inventory_vars[i] + demands[i], name=f"flow_balance_week_{i+1}")
    else:
        m.addConstr(inventory_vars[i-1] + amount_vars[i] == inventory_vars[i] + demands[i], name=f"flow_balance_week_{i+1}")

# Add the order limit constraints
for i in range(21):
    m.addConstr(amount_vars[i] <= 3157 * order_vars[i], name=f"order_limit_week_{i+1}")

# Add the starting and ending inventory constraints
m.addConstr(inventory_vars[0] == 0, name="starting_inventory")
m.addConstr(inventory_vars[20] == 0, name="ending_inventory")

# Set the objective
m.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(ordering_costs[i] * order_vars[i] for i in range(21)) +
    gp.quicksum(unit_purchase_costs[i] * amount_vars[i] for i in range(21)) +
    gp.quicksum(holding_costs[i] * inventory_vars[i] for i in range(21)),
    gp.GRB.MINIMIZE
)

# Optimize the model
m.optimize()

# Print the results
print(json.dumps({"objective_value": float(m.ObjVal), "assignment": {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}}))

from gurobipy import GRB
import math

garbage_amounts = [20, 20, 28, 12, 30, 24, 30, 12, 27, 26, 21, 20, 12, 16, 19]

# Number of trucks and their capacity
num_trucks = 4
truck_capacity = 100
max_distance = 45

# Calculate distances
def distance(p1, p2):
    return math.sqrt((p1[0] - p2[0])**2 + (p1[1] - p2[1])**2)

# Distance from dump to each point
dump = (0, 0)
distances = [distance(dump, p) for p in points]

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Variables
x = {}
for t in range(num_trucks):
    for i in range(len(points)):
        x[f'x_{t}_{i}'] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f'x_{t}_{i}')

# Objective: Minimize total driving distance

import json
import gurobipy as gp

m = gp.Model()

x_sort = m.addVar(name="x_sort", vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, ub=1000)
y_sort = m.addVar(name="y_sort", vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, ub=1000)
x_store = m.addVar(name="x_store", vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, ub=1000)
y_store = m.addVar(name="y_store", vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, ub=1000)

m.addConstr(x_sort - x_store >= 100, name="c1")
m.addConstr(y_sort - y_store >= 100, name="c2")
m.addConstr(x_store - x_sort >= 100, name="c3")
m.addConstr(y_store - y_sort >= 100, name="c4")

m.setObjective(20 * 0.5 * (x_store + y_store) + 15 * 0.5 * (x_sort + y_sort) + 10 * 0.5 * (x_store + y_store) + 25 * 0.5 * (x_sort + y_sort) + 30 * 0.5 * (x_store + y_store) + 40 * 0.5 * (x_sort + y_sort), sense=gp.GRB.MINIMIZE)

m.optimize()

print(json.dumps({"objective_value": float(m.ObjVal), "assignment": {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}}))

import gurobipy as gp

x = {}
for i in range(8):
    for j in range(3):
        x[f'x_{i}_{j}'] = m.addVar(vtype=gp.GRB.BINARY, name=f'x_{i}_{j}')

for i in range(8):
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[f'x_{i}_{j}'] for j in range(3)) == 1, name=f'c1_{i}')

# Truck capacity constraints
processing_times = [4, 5, 3, 6, 2, 5, 4, 3]
truck_capacities = [15, 18, 12]
for j in range(3):
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum((processing_times[i] * (2 if i in [1, 4] else 1)) * x[f'x_{i}_{j}'] for i in range(8)) <= truck_capacities[j], name=f'c2_{j}')

# Objective
truck_costs = [30, 25, 35]
m.setObjective(gp.quicksum((processing_times[i] * (2 if i in [1, 4] else 1) * truck_costs[j]) * x[f'x_{i}_{j}'] for i in range(8) for j in range(3)), sense=gp.GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Optimize
m.optimize()

# Output
print(json.dumps({"objective_value": float(m.ObjVal), "assignment": {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}}))

from gurobipy import GRB

# Distance matrix
distances = [

    [16, 4, 10, 20, 7, 14, 15, 9, 18, 15, 0, 17, 8, 13, 18, 5],

    [17, 7, 11, 6, 11, 8, 9, 13, 16, 9, 5, 7, 17, 12, 11, 0]
]

# Customer daily demand
demands = [25, 30, 20, 15, 35, 40, 18, 22, 28, 32, 19, 21, 26, 24, 23]

# Number of customers
num_customers = len(demands)

# Number of days
num_days = 5

# Number of vehicles
num_vehicles = 3

# Vehicle capacity
vehicle_capacity = 200

# Create the model
m = gp.Model()

# Decision variable: x[i][j][d] = 1 if vehicle travels from customer i to customer j on day d
x = m.addVars(num_customers + 1, num_customers + 1, num_days, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")

# Objective: minimize total distance traveled
m.setObjective(gp.quicksum(distances[i][j] * x[i, j, d] for i in range(num_customers + 1) for j in range(num_customers + 1) for d in range(num_days)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints
# Each customer must be visited according to their delivery frequency
for i in range(1, num_customers + 1):
    if i <= 3:  # Daily delivery
        m.addConstrs(gp.quicksum(x[i, j, d] for j in range(num_customers + 1)) == 1 for d in range(num_days))
    elif i <= 8:  # Every other day delivery
        m.addConstrs(gp.quicksum(x[i, j, d] for j in range(num_customers + 1)) == 1 for d in range(0, num_days, 2))
    else:  # Weekly delivery
        m.addConstrs(gp.quicksum(x[i, j, d] for j in range(num_customers + 1)) == 1 for d in range(num_days) if d == 0)

# Vehicle capacity constraint
for d in range(num_days):
    for v in range(num_vehicles):
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(demands[i - 1] * x[i, j, d] for i in range(1, num_customers + 1) for j in range(num_customers + 1)) <= vehicle_capacity)

# Daily vehicle limit constraint
for d in range(num_days):
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[0, j, d] for j in range(1, num_customers + 1)) <= num_vehicles)

# Optimize the model
m.optimize()

# Print the results
print(json.dumps({"objective_value": float(m.ObjVal), "assignment": {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}}))

from gurobipy import GRB

jobs = 10
machines = 3
processing_times = [
    [11, 23, 25],
    [26, 6, 30],
    [19, 21, 13],
    [23, 23, 21],
    [14, 22, 15],
    [12, 19, 28],
    [9, 17, 22],
    [30, 20, 7],
    [28, 11, 12],
    [6, 10, 9]
]
machine_assignments = [
    [1, 0, 2],
    [1, 0, 2],
    [2, 0, 1],
    [1, 2, 0],
    [1, 0, 2],
    [0, 1, 2],
    [0, 2, 1],
    [2, 0, 1],
    [2, 0, 1],
    [2, 1, 0]
]

# Create the model
m = gp.Model()

# Define variables
start_time = m.addVars(jobs, 3, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="start_time")
makespan = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="makespan")

# Add job precedence constraints
for j in range(jobs):
    for o in range(1, 3):
        m.addConstr(start_time[j, o] >= start_time[j, o-1] + processing_times[j][o-1], name=f"job_precedence_{j}_{o}")

# Add machine capacity constraints
for m in range(machines):
    for t in range(100):  # Assuming a reasonable upper bound for time
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum((start_time[j, o] <= t) * (start_time[j, o] + processing_times[j][o] > t) for j in range(jobs) for o in range(3) if machine_assignments[j][o] == m) <= 1, name=f"machine_capacity_{m}_{t}")

# Add makespan constraint
for j in range(jobs):
    m.addConstr(makespan >= start_time[j, 2] + processing_times[j][2], name=f"makespan_constraint_{j}")

m.setObjective(makespan, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Print the results

import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Define the problem data
jobs = 9
machines = 4
operations = 4

# Machine assignments by job and operation
machine_assignments = [
    [1, 0, 2, 3],
    [3, 0, 2, 1],
    [2, 1, 0, 3],
    [1, 2, 0, 3],
    [1, 3, 0, 2],
    [1, 2, 3, 0],
    [2, 3, 1, 0],
    [1, 3, 2, 0],
    [0, 3, 1, 2]
]

# Processing times by job and operation
processing_times = [
    [15, 29, 11, 24],
    [13, 13, 28, 7],
    [15, 12, 6, 28],
    [27, 16, 19, 5],
    [26, 8, 14, 16],
    [24, 23, 21, 6],
    [22, 28, 6, 6],
    [16, 9, 10, 30],
    [19, 8, 28, 17]
]

# Create the model
m = gp.Model()

# Variables
start_time = m.addVars(jobs, operations, name="start_time", vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0)
end_time = m.addVars(jobs, operations, name="end_time", vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0)
x = m.addVars(jobs, operations, jobs, operations, name="x", vtype=GRB.BINARY)

# Constraints
# Job sequence constraints
for j in range(jobs):
    for o in range(1, operations):
        m.addConstr(start_time[j, o] >= end_time[j, o-1], name=f"job_sequence_{j}_{o}")

# Machine exclusivity constraints
for m in range(machines):
    for t in range(1000):  # Assuming a large enough time horizon
        for j1 in range(jobs):
            for o1 in range(operations):
                if machine_assignments[j1][o1] == m:
                    for j2 in range(jobs):

                            if j1 != j2 and machine_assignments[j2][o2] == m:

# No interruption constraints

    for o in range(operations):

m.optimize()

import json
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Data
depot = (50, 50)
customers = {
    'C1': {'coords': (41, 83), 'demand': 11, 'time_window': [53, 123], 'service_time': 8},
    'C2': {'coords': (20, 56), 'demand': 22, 'time_window': [31, 131], 'service_time': 14},
    'C3': {'coords': (48, 35), 'demand': 19, 'time_window': [13, 106], 'service_time': 14},
    'C4': {'coords': (86, 18), 'demand': 23, 'time_window': [48, 99], 'service_time': 13},
    'C5': {'coords': (33, 9), 'demand': 24, 'time_window': [51, 125], 'service_time': 13}
}
vehicle_capacity = 49
num_vehicles = 3
fixed_cost = 100.0
depot_closing_time = 293

# Distance function
def distance(p1, p2):
    return ((p1[0] - p2[0]) ** 2 + (p1[1] - p2[1]) ** 2) ** 0.5

# Model
m = gp.Model()

# Variables
x = m.addVars([(i, j) for i in customers for j in customers], vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")
t = m.addVars(customers, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="t")
y = m.addVars(range(num_vehicles), vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="y")

# Constraints
# Each customer is visited exactly once
m.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in customers if i != j) == 1 for i in customers), name="each_customer_visited_once")

# Vehicle capacity
m.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(customers[j]['demand'] * x[i, j] for j in customers if i != j) <= vehicle_capacity * y[v] for i in customers for v in range(num_vehicles)), name="vehicle_capacity")

# Time windows
m.addConstrs((t[i] >= customers[i]['time_window'][0] for i in customers), name="time_window_earliest")
m.addConstrs((t[i] <= customers[i]['time_window'][1] for i in customers), name="time_window_latest")

# Service time
m.addConstrs((t[j] >= t[i] + distance(customers[i]['coords'], customers[j]['coords']) + customers[i]['service_time'] - 1000 * (1 - x[i, j]) for i in customers for j in customers if i != j), name="service_time")

# Vehicle usage
m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(y[v] for v in range(num_vehicles)) <= num_vehicles, name="vehicle_usage")

# Depot return time
m.addConstrs((t[i] + distance(customers[i]['coords'], depot) <= depot_closing_time for i in customers), name="depot_return_time")

# Objective
m.setObjective(gp.quicksum(distance(customers[i]['coords'], customers[j]['coords']) * x[i, j] for i in customers for j in customers if i != j) + fixed_cost * gp.quicksum(y[v] for v in range(num_vehicles)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Optimize
m.optimize()

# Output
print(json.dumps({"objective_value": float(m.ObjVal), "assignment": {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}}))
